headline: The missed-move gap is foresight, not timing: ~4.5 big moves a day that Live misses still have a full daily range left after 09:50. The next step is a hunt for a new side signal. Live reps rose 12% over forecast after the restructure (PR #229).
bullets: Live reps (REPS3): forecast setups ran 521 setup-days a week vs 465 forecast (+12%, bench-adjusted). Gen halt and buying-power skips fell from 66/60 to 0 per session. A busier market (SPY range 1.46% vs 1.23%) explains part.

Missed moves (A1, descriptive): Live's misses are still mostly ahead at 09:50, but much of that is selection. What survives is ~4.5 non-ETF moves/day with >= 1 ATR left, no setup or wrong side. That gap is knowing which name and side.
SIDEHUNT opened: list every possible direction signal for in-play names at 09:50, closed or untried. Candidates include quote imbalance, up/down volume share and position vs VWAP / early range.
Trades within one setup-day are correlated (ICC 0.22), so a setup is judged by its setup-days. Earnings Shadow (FAMC): -0.112R without its best day, too early to read.
Rule changes in the window: TSZ1 testing sizing, RULE21-DB, Workbench copies, ROT1, GY-BENCH, promotion hold (56 ledger entries 11-12..11-18).
